about: Budget eval cases: a fixed scenario run as a whole headless session (claude -p --output-format json) inside the fixture project under fixtures/budget-project, checked against a token budget. total counts every token the session processed, cache reads included, because each turn re-reads the context; fresh counts input, cache writes and output. Budgets are ceilings calibrated on a real run (see each why) and tightened as the plugin gets cheaper; a case that starts failing means a regression in turns or context, not a flaky judge. Run explicitly: node scripts/run-evals.mjs --suite budget. <plugin-root> in a prompt is replaced by the plugin's path.

cases.why: The resume snapshot is one acdev.mjs status call and must not scan the repo. Calibrated 2026-09-07 on acdev 0.4.2 with the haiku judge: 2 turns, 64,593 total / 11,066 fresh tokens, $0.030; ceilings are that run plus about 25 percent (fresh is dominated by the one-time cache write of the system prompt, which the plugin does not control).

cases.prompt: Run node "<plugin-root>/scripts/acdev.mjs" next and reply with the step id and the next_step line only.
cases.why: One command, one answer: the dispenser must cost one tool call. Calibrated 2026-09-07 on acdev 0.4.2 with the haiku judge: 2 turns, 62,679 total / 9,654 fresh tokens, $0.025; ceilings are that run plus about 25 percent (fresh is dominated by the one-time cache write of the system prompt, which the plugin does not control).

cases.prompt: Run node "<plugin-root>/scripts/acdev.mjs" pack --layers api and reply with the number of ADR decisions and the number of checklist items it printed.
cases.why: The pack replaces reading ADRs, ROADMAP and checkpoints; it must stay one call and about 2k tokens. Calibrated 2026-09-07 on acdev 0.4.2 with the haiku judge: 2 turns, 63,560 total / 10,527 fresh tokens, $0.028; ceilings are that run plus about 25 percent (fresh is dominated by the one-time cache write of the system prompt, which the plugin does not control).
